subject.title: fix(memory-wiki): reject oversized apply body files

question: Should `wiki apply synthesis --body-file` newly reject all regular files larger than 1 MiB, despite current main accepting them?
rationale: This is a user-visible CLI compatibility boundary, and the repository policy requires owner judgment before introducing a new runtime failure or strict input contract for existing workflows.

options.title: Preserve regular-file compatibility
options.body: Remove the unconditional 1 MiB rejection, retain safe non-regular-file handling, and address resource concerns only through an owner-approved design.

options.title: Approve a documented 1 MiB contract
options.body: Keep the cap only after explicitly accepting the break for existing large-file workflows and adding clear CLI and upgrade documentation.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Close or defer this implementation until memory-wiki owners choose a durable input-size policy.

recommendation.title: Preserve regular-file compatibility
recommendation.body: Remove the unconditional 1 MiB rejection, retain safe non-regular-file handling, and address resource concerns only through an owner-approved design.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining question is product and compatibility direction, and the PR discussion explicitly routed attention to this contact.
